title: Female Warrior with Hammer
description: A dynamic full-body illustration of a young female warrior with dark hair in a high ponytail, captured mid-action. She wears a white and purple cropped top with matching arm wraps, loose white pants with purple accents, and is performing a high kick while wielding a massive purple warhammer with glowing crack patterns.
prompt: A fierce young East Asian female warrior with dark hair in a high ponytail, wearing a cropped white and purple patterned top that exposes her midriff, loose white pants with purple wraps and tassels, and matching purple arm guards and boots. Clean studio lighting against a solid gray background, detailed digital character art style.
